releaseNotes: feat: implement asset hashing for PC UI version and add service worker
changelog: Added SHA-256 hashing for assets in the PC directory to generate a unique version string.
Updated build configuration to include the generated PC_UI_VERSION.
Introduced a service worker (sw.js) to manage caching and offline capabilities.
Modified the HTTP server to inject the PC_UI_VERSION into the service worker.
Enhanced file management UI with new file creation functionality and improved upload handling.
Updated translations for new file prompts in Arabic and English.
Refactored server tab views to include backup and database creation modals.
Improved user experience by managing reload blockers during file uploads and editor interactions.
